lean_to_weight_gain.condition: PCOD (Lean Type) with Hairfall, Weakness, Heavy Periods

meals.benefit: Helps improve energy levels, supports hair growth & reduces weakness caused by heavy periods

meals.food: 1 banana / chikoo / mango (seasonal)

meals.food: 2 multigrain roti + 1 bowl sabzi + 1 bowl dal/paneer + 1 bowl curd  |  Small portion salad before meal
meals.benefit: Balanced nutrition improves digestion, supports hormones & reduces weakness

general_pcod_pcos.subtitle: Plan focuses on regulating hormones, improving ovulation and stabilizing insulin levels
understandingItems: Irregular periods are mainly due to hormonal imbalance.
This plan focuses on regulating hormones, improving ovulation and stabilizing insulin levels.

items: Warm water with soaked methi seeds (4–5 seeds, 4 times/week)
10–15 min sunlight exposure for Vitamin D
Paneer bhurji / Eggs / Moong dal chilla
Low GI fruit: Apple / Guava / Papaya
1 tsp pumpkin seeds (zinc for hormone support)

advancedTips: Seed Cycling: flax + pumpkin (first half cycle), sesame + sunflower (second half)
Protein in every meal improves ovulation
general_pcod_pcos.note: This is a general plan. Follow consistently for 6–8 weeks for visible results.
